meta.title: Diagram viewer
meta.description: Turns mermaid and mmd code fences in chat into clearly structured Mermaid diagrams. Supports sequence diagrams, flowcharts and other Mermaid types, with source switching, zoom, fit-to-width and expanded reading. Follows light and dark themes. Preserves source while streaming and on errors, with retry feedback. Renders in the local page without an external chart service; ignores embedded theme configuration and disables external images, links and callbacks. Compatible with DSH 0.2.2-rc.5.

ui.streaming: Generating code. The diagram will appear when complete.
ui.invalid: Check the Mermaid syntax. The original code is preserved.
ui.tooLarge: This diagram exceeds rendering limits. Split it into smaller diagrams.
ui.customStyle: Diagrams use the plugin theme. Custom CSS commands (classDef / style / linkStyle) are disabled; remove these statements before retrying.
ui.unsupportedMetadata: The @{…} shape metadata syntax is disabled to prevent image or icon requests. Use classic nodes such as A[Node] instead.
ui.externalAsset: This diagram contains blocked resource syntax or unsafe styling. Remove images, external resource references and injected styles before retrying.
ui.hint: Scroll sideways for wide diagrams; expand to read long diagrams.
